explanation.what_was_found: Exposed high-entropy synthetic secret or plaintext credential detected in /api/v1/auth/verify.
explanation.why_it_matters: Hardcoded credentials in distributed code or environment manifests risk unauthorized cloud infrastructure access.
explanation.possible_impact: Compromise of backend databases, unauthorized cloud resource orchestration, lateral movement.
explanation.recommended_action: Immediately revoke and rotate the exposed credential and migrate secrets to a dedicated vault.
explanation.how_to_fix:
1. Revoke the credential in the respective provider IAM console.
2. Add configuration manifest to .gitignore.
3. Inject credentials via secure runtime secret managers (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager / Vault).
explanation.how_to_verify: Scan git history using local entropy checks and confirm rotated credential returns 401 Unauthorized.

retrieved_sources.title: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function — Step-by-Step Remediation
retrieved_sources.text:
REMEDIATION & HARDENING GUIDANCE FOR CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function (CWE-306):
Recommended Engineering Actions:
1. Require strong multi-factor authentication for sensitive management APIs.
2. Verify authentication tokens across all microservices.
3. Centralize identity verification in API Gateway.
Compliance & Reference Standards: https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/306.html

retrieved_sources.title: Authentication Architecture & Multi-Factor Security Enforcement — Step-by-Step Remediation
retrieved_sources.text:
REMEDIATION & HARDENING GUIDANCE FOR Authentication Architecture & Multi-Factor Security Enforcement (CWE-306):
Recommended Engineering Actions:
1. Require authenticated session tokens or cryptographically signed JWTs on every API endpoint by default.
2. Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA / WebAuthn) for privileged and administrative portals.
3. Implement centralized authentication middleware that denies unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401.
4. Prevent broken object level and function level authorization via granular RBAC/ABAC role checks.
Compliance & Reference Standards: https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/306.html, https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authentication_Cheat_Sheet.html
